newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were generally steady, compared to last week, USDA said.

Bulk supply Medium and Large 1-2 300- 750 lb feeder steers and heifers. Trade moderate. Demand good especially for thin-fleshed kinds suitable for grazing. Quality not as attractive as last several weeks.
Feeder steers and heifers under 600 lbs 78 percent, over
600 lbs 20 percent with cows and bulls around 2 percent of
